title: Main Khiladi Tu Anari
desc: A Bombay police officer seeks revenge when a drug dealer kills his brother. However, things get complicated when a film star begins to tag along, so that he can research a film role.

title: Supreme Khiladi
desc: A charitable trust faces threats from a powerful mafia leader who has set his eyes on its land. He plans to kill the legal heir to grab the wealth, but a brave taxi driver becomes an impediment.

title: Jung
desc: Desperate to save his son's life, Veer, an honest cop, is faced with an impossible choice when he discovers that the only person who can help him is a notorious criminal behind bars.

title: Real Tevar
desc: Harsha is the idealistic scion of a self-made multimillionaire, Ravikanth. After a chance meeting with Charuseela leads him to a remote village, Harsha wishes to develop it with her help.

title: Narsimha
desc: Narasimha, an assassin, works for Bapji, a powerful thug, and kills people on his behalf. However, things take a turn when he is ordered to murder Ravi, and he declines to follow the order.
